title: So Long, and Thanks for All the Fish
author: Douglas Adams
summary: After years drifting through the galaxy, Arthur Dent finds his way home to an oddly ordinary life, and to a love story he never planned. It is the quietest and most romantic Hitchhiker's book, still full of dry jokes.
readIf: you like Douglas Adams and want a gentler instalment with a love story at its centre.
skipIf: you want the frantic space-hopping of the first two books, or have not started the series.

pairings.reason: Shares the same wry, English way of treating cosmic stakes as a bit of an administrative muddle.
A modern, equally playful science-fiction comedy that pokes at its own genre.
A warm, funny love story about an awkward man learning something about connection.
